items.name: Mattresses
items.description: Orthopaedic, memory-foam and pocket-spring mattresses in every standard Nepali bed size. Softer comfort grades for family bedrooms, and denser medium-firm builds for guest rooms that change occupant nightly.
items.shortDescription: Orthopaedic, memory-foam and pocket-spring mattresses in every standard Nepali bed size.
items.material: High-density PU foam, cooling gel-memory foam and individually pocketed spring cores. Covers are quilted knit or damask, and the spring ranges use a reinforced perimeter so the edge doesn't collapse when you sit on it.
items.care: Rotate head-to-toe every three months — foam and spring both settle unevenly otherwise. Spot clean only; never soak a foam core. A fitted protector is worth it in any bed that sees guests.
highlights: Soft, medium and firm grades, so you can match the sleeper rather than the room
Pocket springs isolate movement — the practical pick for a shared bed
Breathable knit covers, chosen for Pokhara's humid monsoon months
Old mattress removal on delivery
items.homesSummary: For family bedrooms we lean towards medium and soft grades with a plusher comfort layer — a mattress you'll keep eight to ten years and actually enjoy sleeping on.
homesPoints: Memory-foam and hybrid comfort layers for pressure relief
Single and double sizes for children's and guest rooms
Try the firmness grades side by side in the showroom
items.hotelsSummary: Properties get the firmer, denser builds. Guests vary hugely in weight and preference, so a medium-firm pocket spring is the safe specification, and it survives a nightly change of occupant far better.
hotelsPoints: Medium-firm pocket spring as the standard guest-room specification
Consistent build across every room, with stock held for replacements
Waterproof protectors supplied as standard on trade orders
Phased delivery floor by floor so rooms stay sellable

items.name: Bedsheets
items.description: Two distinct ranges from one supplier: printed and dyed cotton for households who want colour on the bed, and plain white hotel-weight cotton and linen for properties that need bleach-tolerant stock they can match years later.
items.shortDescription: Printed cotton sets for homes; plain hotel-weight cotton and linen for properties.
items.material: 200–300 thread-count long-staple cotton in percale (crisp, cool, matte) and sateen (softer, slight sheen), plus washed linen and cotton-linen blends in the trade range.
items.care: Wash before first use to set the weave. Warm wash with like colours, tumble dry low. Skip fabric softener on percale — it flattens the crispness people buy it for.
highlights: Sold as full sets or as individual replacements when one piece wears out
Deep-pocket fitted sheets that stay on thicker mattresses
Reactive dyes that survive repeated hot washes without greying
Sizes cut for Nepali bed dimensions, not generic imports
items.homesSummary: Households get the colour and the pattern — printed and dyed cotton in florals, geometrics and plain brights, in the softer sateen finishes that feel good on a bed you're not changing daily.
homesPoints: Printed and colourful cotton in a wide seasonal range
Softer sateen finishes for everyday comfort
Coordinated pillowcases, and matching duvet covers where available
Single through king, including children's prints
items.hotelsSummary: Hotels, resorts and serviced apartments get plain white and ivory in cotton and linen. Undyed and bleach-tolerant, so a stained sheet can be recovered rather than written off, and one damaged piece is replaceable from stock years later.
hotelsPoints: Plain white and ivory only — no dye to fade unevenly across a floor
Bleach-tolerant construction for commercial laundry cycles
Linen and cotton-linen for resorts wanting a relaxed, textured look
Reinforced hems and consistent sizing for flat-sheet presentation
Held as an ongoing stock line so replacements match

items.name: Duvets
items.description: Microfibre and down-alternative duvets, baffle-box stitched so the fill stays put. Heavier winter weights for unheated Pokhara bedrooms, and a mid-weight white specification for properties running one duvet type year-round.
items.shortDescription: Microfibre and down-alternative duvets in all-season and winter weights.
items.material: Siliconised hollow-fibre and down-alternative fills in a downproof cotton cambric shell, baffle-box stitched so the filling can't migrate to the corners.
items.care: Always use a washable cover. Air it in sunlight every few weeks; full cleaning once a season is plenty.
highlights: All-season and winter weights — Pokhara genuinely needs both
Baffle-box construction holds loft after repeated washing
Hypoallergenic fills throughout
Covers available in the matching bedsheet ranges
items.homesSummary: For homes we pair a warm winter-weight duvet with decorative covers you can change with the season, so one duvet works year-round with a lighter cover in spring.
homesPoints: Heavier winter fills for unheated Pokhara bedrooms
Printed and coloured covers to match your bedsheets
Single through king, including children's sizes
items.hotelsSummary: Properties get white, washable and identical across every room. We specify a mid-weight fill that suits most guests year-round and keeps housekeeping to one duvet type rather than a seasonal swap.
hotelsPoints: White only, with plain white covers for a clean turndown
Mid-weight fill that works across seasons — one SKU, not two
Machine-washable at commercial temperatures
Spare stock held so a soiled duvet is swapped, not the room lost

items.name: Pillows & Covers
items.description: Fibre, memory-foam and latex pillows with zippered protectors. Matched to the individual sleeper at home, or set up as a two-option pillow menu for guest rooms.
items.shortDescription: Fibre, memory-foam and latex pillows with zippered protectors.
items.material: Siliconised hollow-fibre, moulded memory foam and natural latex, in cotton or cotton-blend casings. Protectors are zippered cotton with a fine-gauge closure.
items.care: Fibre pillows machine wash and need a thorough dry. Foam and latex are spot clean and air only — washing breaks the core down.
highlights: Soft, medium and firm lofts across the range
Zippered protectors, the single biggest factor in pillow lifespan
Latex options for anyone who overheats on foam
Bolsters and decorative cushions to match soft furnishings
items.homesSummary: At home it's about the individual sleeper — we'll match loft and fill to how you actually sleep, plus decorative cushions and bolsters that tie the bed into the room.
homesPoints: Fill and loft matched to side, back or front sleepers
Decorative cushions and bolsters in coordinating fabrics
Try the lofts in the showroom before committing
items.hotelsSummary: For properties we set up a pillow menu — typically a soft and a firm option per bed — so guests self-select without housekeeping stocking six variants.
hotelsPoints: Two-option pillow menu: one soft, one firm, per bed
White protectors on every pillow as standard
Uniform loft across rooms so beds present identically
Bulk replacement stock on an agreed reorder cycle

items.name: Curtains
items.description: Made-to-measure drapery, measured and installed by our own fitters. Patterned and textured fabrics for homes; three-pass blackout with overlapping closures for guest rooms that need to stay dark at 6am.
items.shortDescription: Made-to-measure drapery, measured and installed by our own fitters.
items.material: Faux silk, cotton-linen, velvet, jacquard and polyester sheers. Linings run from standard cotton through dim-out to full three-pass blackout.
items.care: Vacuum on low monthly — dust is what ages curtains. Dry clean anything lined or velvet; unlined cotton washes cool and should be rehung slightly damp.
highlights: Measured on site, stitched to size, and hung by the people who quoted it
Pinch pleat, eyelet, rod pocket and wave headings
Blackout, dim-out and light-filtering linings
Supplied with matched tracks, rods and tie-backs
items.homesSummary: Homes get the decorative end of the range — patterned jacquards, textured linens and layered sheers, chosen to suit the room rather than to a fixed spec.
homesPoints: Patterned, textured and jacquard fabrics
Layered sheer-plus-drape treatments for living rooms
Decorative poles, finials and tie-backs
Single windows and bay runs both handled
items.hotelsSummary: Guest rooms need blackout that genuinely blacks out, in one fabric repeated across every room. We specify heavier three-pass linings and overlapping centre closures so light doesn't leak down the middle at 6am.
hotelsPoints: Three-pass blackout lining with overlapping centre closure
One specification repeated across every room on a floor
Heavier headers and reinforced stitching for daily operation
Fire-retardant fabric options for public areas
Sheers for lobbies and restaurants where light is wanted

items.name: Curtain Tracks & Rods
items.description: Manual, corded and motorised tracks alongside decorative poles and finials. Hardware on show for homes, concealed ceiling track and motorised runs for properties.
items.shortDescription: Manual, corded and motorised tracks, plus decorative poles and finials.
items.material: Powder-coated aluminium track profiles and steel poles, finished in brushed brass, matte black, antique bronze and wood-effect.
items.care: Keep the track channel free of dust so gliders run silently. Wipe poles with a dry cloth — solvents strip the finish.
highlights: Ceiling and wall mounting, including bay and corner runs
Silent-glide systems, noticeably better in bedrooms
Motorised options with remote or wall switch
Brackets, finials and tie-back hooks matched to the finish
items.homesSummary: Homes usually want the hardware on show — decorative poles with finials in a finish that suits the room, in manual operation.
homesPoints: Decorative poles and finials in four finishes
Simple manual operation, no cords to manage
Cut to width on site, including bay windows
items.hotelsSummary: Properties get concealed ceiling track so the hardware disappears, with motorisation on the tall window walls where a guest can't reach the top of the drape.
hotelsPoints: Concealed ceiling track — hardware out of sight
Motorised runs for floor-to-ceiling and window-wall glazing
Heavy-duty gliders rated for daily operation
Cord-free options where child safety is a requirement

items.name: Carpets
items.description: Wall-to-wall and area carpets, fitted and finished on site. Wool and wool blends where underfoot comfort matters, and solution-dyed commercial nylon rated for corridors and lobbies.
items.shortDescription: Wall-to-wall and area carpets, fitted and finished on site.
items.material: Solution-dyed nylon and polypropylene in commercial weights, plus wool and wool-blend piles for residential use. Felt or rubber backing depending on subfloor.
items.care: Vacuum twice weekly in anything busy. Hot-water extraction once or twice a year; blot spills immediately rather than rubbing.
highlights: Commercial-rated piles for corridors and lobbies
Solution-dyed fibre — colour runs through, so it doesn't bleach out
Fitted, seamed and edge-finished by our installers
Underlay specified to the subfloor, not sold as an afterthought
items.homesSummary: At home the priority is underfoot feel, so we point people towards wool and wool-blend piles in bedrooms and living rooms, in warmer, deeper textures.
homesPoints: Wool and wool-blend piles for warmth and softness
Bedroom and living-room weights
Area carpets if you'd rather not fit wall-to-wall
items.hotelsSummary: Corridors and lobbies are a wear problem, not a comfort one. We specify solution-dyed commercial nylon with a heavy-traffic rating and a pattern that disguises tracking between the lift and the rooms.
hotelsPoints: Heavy-traffic commercial rating for corridors and lobbies
Patterned designs that disguise wear and foot tracking
Stain-resistant treatment applied as standard
Fitted overnight or floor by floor to keep the property trading

items.name: Blinds
items.description: Roller, roman, venetian and zebra blinds made to measure. Wipeable finishes for kitchens and bathrooms at home; blackout rollers behind drapes and sunscreen fabric for public areas in properties.
items.shortDescription: Roller, roman, venetian and zebra blinds, made to measure.
items.material: Polyester screen fabrics in sunscreen, dim-out and blackout grades; aluminium and PVC slats; wood-effect composite venetians.
items.care: Dust slats along their length regularly. Fabric blinds take a barely damp cloth — soaking leaves a tide mark.
highlights: Blackout, dim-out and sunscreen fabrics graded by room use
Chain, cord and motorised controls
Child-safe fittings available and worth specifying with young children
Compact stack where curtains would crowd the window
items.homesSummary: Homes tend to want blinds where curtains don't suit — kitchens, bathrooms and home offices — so we lean on wipeable PVC and wood-effect venetians, plus roman blinds where a softer look is wanted.
homesPoints: Wipeable PVC and aluminium for kitchens and bathrooms
Roman blinds in fabric for a softer finish
Wood-effect venetians for studies and living rooms
items.hotelsSummary: In properties blinds usually sit behind a drape as the blackout layer, or handle glare in restaurants and meeting rooms. Specification is uniform and operation has to survive guests.
hotelsPoints: Blackout roller behind drapes as the light-control layer
Sunscreen fabric for restaurants, lobbies and meeting rooms
Robust mechanisms rated for guest operation
Cord-free and motorised options for safety compliance

items.name: Rugs
items.description: Hand-knotted Tibetan and Nepali wool alongside power-loomed synthetics. A decorative anchor in a living room, or a bespoke statement piece sized to a hotel reception.
items.shortDescription: Hand-knotted and machine-woven rugs, including custom sizes.
items.material: Hand-knotted Tibetan and Nepali wool, wool-viscose blends for sheen, and power-loomed polypropylene where durability matters more than fibre.
items.care: Rotate twice a year so wear and sunlight even out. Use a pad underneath — it stops slipping and roughly doubles the life of the pile.
highlights: Traditional Nepali and Tibetan knotting alongside plain modern designs
Custom sizes and shapes cut and bound to order
Wool for longevity, synthetics for spill-heavy rooms
Anti-slip pads supplied with every rug
items.homesSummary: In a home a rug is usually doing a decorative job — anchoring a seating area or warming a floor — so we show wool for longevity and easy-clean synthetics for rooms with children or pets.
homesPoints: Living-room sizes that anchor a seating arrangement
Easy-clean synthetic pile for family rooms
Runners for hallways and stairs
items.hotelsSummary: For properties a rug is usually a statement in reception or a suite, so hand-knotted wool earns its cost. We can also produce a custom design and size for a specific space.
hotelsPoints: Hand-knotted wool for reception and suite floors
Custom sizes, shapes and designs to a brief
Dense pile constructions that recover from furniture indentation

items.name: Sofa & Cushion Covers
items.description: Loose covers, cushion covers and full reupholstery of frames you already own. Patterned fabrics for homes, and rub-tested performance weaves for lobby and restaurant seating.
items.shortDescription: Loose covers, cushion covers and full reupholstery of existing frames.
items.material: Cotton-linen, chenille, velvet and performance weaves with soil-resistant finishes. Cushion inserts in feather and hollow-fibre.
items.care: Removable covers wash cool and should be put back slightly damp for a clean fit. Fixed upholstery needs professional cleaning.
highlights: Loose covers or complete reupholstery of a frame you already own
Piping, welt and contrast trim to your specification
Templated on site so the fit is tailored, not approximate
Feather and hollow-fibre inserts
items.homesSummary: Reupholstering a sofa you like is usually cheaper than replacing it, and it lets you change the room without changing the furniture. Cushion covers are the low-commitment version of the same idea.
homesPoints: Reupholster an existing frame rather than replacing it
Seasonal cushion covers to refresh a room cheaply
Patterned and textured fabrics for living spaces
items.hotelsSummary: Lobby and restaurant seating takes constant use, so we specify performance fabrics with soil-resistant finishes and rub-test ratings suited to public areas, and can refit an entire lounge in one visit.
hotelsPoints: Performance fabrics rated for public-area use
Soil and stain-resistant finishes as standard
Whole-lounge refits handled in a single scheduled visit
Matching cushions across a seating scheme

items.name: Table Linen & Kitchen Textiles
items.description: Tablecloths, runners, napkins and skirting. Coloured cotton-rich cloths for the dining table at home, and soil-release spun polyester sized to your covers for restaurant and banquet service.
items.shortDescription: Tablecloths, runners, napkins, skirting and kitchen textiles.
items.material: Spun polyester and cotton-rich blends with soil-release finishes; damask weaves for banqueting; cotton drill for aprons and kitchen cloths.
items.care: Wash hot with an oxygen stain remover. Tumble low and press slightly damp — polyester creases set hard if it's over-dried.
highlights: Sized for round, rectangular and banquet tables
Soil-release finishes that lift oil and food in a normal wash
Matching napkins, runners and skirting
Aprons, oven gloves and kitchen cloths in the same range
items.homesSummary: For the dining table at home we stock cotton-rich cloths and runners in colours and prints — the sort of thing that comes out for guests and washes without ceremony.
homesPoints: Coloured and printed cotton-rich cloths and runners
Standard dining-table sizes, six and eight seat
Matching napkin sets
items.hotelsSummary: Restaurant and banqueting linen is a laundry problem first. We specify soil-release spun polyester in white and house colours, sized precisely to your tables, with enough stock in rotation to cover turnaround.
hotelsPoints: Sized precisely to your table dimensions, including banquet trestles
Soil-release spun polyester built for daily commercial laundering
Table skirting and overlays for events and conferencing
Stock depth calculated for your laundry turnaround

items.name: Towels
items.description: Ring-spun cotton towels graded by GSM, from face cloth to pool sheet. The full colour range for homes; white only for properties, so stained stock can be bleached back rather than replaced.
items.shortDescription: Ring-spun cotton towels graded by GSM, from face cloth to pool sheet.
items.material: 500–650 GSM ring-spun and combed cotton with double-stitched hems and a low-lint finish. Higher GSM is heavier and more absorbent but slower to dry.
items.care: Wash warm without fabric softener — softener coats the pile and is the usual reason towels stop absorbing. Tumble dry to lift the loops.
highlights: GSM graded so bath, hand, face and pool towels can be specified separately
Double-stitched hems that survive commercial laundering
Chlorine-resistant options for pool and spa
Matching bath mats
items.homesSummary: At home you can have the colour. We stock the full range in dyed cotton, and lean towards the higher GSM weights — a heavier towel is the one that feels expensive.
homesPoints: Full colour range in dyed, colour-fast cotton
Heavier 600 GSM+ weights for a plush feel
Family sets in mixed sizes
items.hotelsSummary: Properties get white, because white can be bleached back and mismatched greying across a floor is the fastest way a bathroom looks tired. We grade GSM by area — lighter for pool, heavier for guest bathrooms.
hotelsPoints: White only, so stained stock can be bleached rather than binned
GSM graded by area: pool, guest bathroom, spa
Chlorine-resistant construction for poolside
Reinforced hems for high-temperature commercial laundry
Ongoing stock line so replacements match existing inventory

items.name: Bath Robes & Slippers
items.description: Waffle and terry robes with matched slippers. Sold individually for personal use, or supplied in bulk with embroidered property branding and spa variants.
items.shortDescription: Waffle and terry robes with disposable or reusable slippers.
items.material: Cotton terry, velour and lightweight waffle weave. Slippers in cotton terry, coral fleece and disposable non-woven, with anti-slip soles.
items.care: Wash robes warm and skip softener on terry. Reusable slippers wash cool in a laundry bag to keep their shape.
highlights: Waffle for warm months, terry for winter and spa use
Unisex S/M and L/XL sizing keeps stockholding simple
Open-toe and closed-toe slippers, disposable or reusable
Embroidery available for property branding
items.homesSummary: Mostly bought as a gift or for personal use at home — the heavier terry robes, in the same weights hotels use, without the branding.
homesPoints: Heavier terry robes for everyday use
Sold individually rather than in bulk
Popular as a wedding or housewarming gift
items.hotelsSummary: A robe is a visible amenity, so it's worth getting right. Waffle reads lighter and dries faster; terry reads more luxurious. We supply either with embroidered branding and matched slippers.
hotelsPoints: Embroidered with your property branding
Waffle for fast laundry turnaround, terry for a premium feel
Matched slippers, disposable for turnover or reusable for suites
Spa and pool variants alongside guest-room stock

items.name: Hotel Furnishings
items.description: Whole-room furnishing packages — bed, linen, window treatment, flooring and soft furnishings specified together, priced per room, and repeatable across a floor or an entire property.
items.shortDescription: Whole-room furnishing packages specified, supplied and installed per property.
items.material: Coordinated packages drawn from our own ranges and sourced lines, specified to your brief, budget and the wear the space will actually see.
items.care: Every package ships with a per-item care and laundry guide for your housekeeping team.
highlights: Bed, linen, window treatment, flooring and soft furnishings in one specification
Consistent across every room, and repeatable years later
Phased delivery so floors are refitted without closing
One point of contact from specification to handover
items.homesSummary: The same whole-room approach works for a house or apartment you'd rather not furnish piecemeal — we specify the room, supply it and fit it in one go.
homesPoints: Whole-room packages for new builds and full renovations
One visit to measure everything, one delivery, one installation
Useful for rental apartments being fitted out to let
items.hotelsSummary: This is our core trade offering: a room specification you can repeat across a floor or a property, priced per room, with stock held so a replacement in year three still matches year one.
hotelsPoints: Priced per room, so budgeting scales with the room count
Standard, deluxe and suite specifications
Held stock so later replacements match the original fit-out
Phased floor-by-floor delivery for properties still trading
Single contact from specification through to handover
